source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately reporting failed municipal water-quality tests to protect the public

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion: Determine which test (routine or special purpose monitoring) is evaluated. 3. Check that all the following is true: * The Public Water System (PWS) failed or exceeded its safe drinking water standards. * The PWS failed to test during the proper frequency. * The PWS failed to get permit approval or failed to submit proper documents of approval. * The PWS failed to collect appropriate samples or test during the proper time frame. * The PWS failed to be within its licensing requirements. * The PWS failed to treat its water properly. * The PWS failed to meet its capacity assurances or requirements. 4. Check in the inspection record if the PWS is required to report a Level 1 or Level 2 violation. If yes, contact the PWS and request the failed test data. If no, report the violation. 5. Obtain available analytical data and note
